component.name: SideX
component.summary: VS Code rebuilt on Tauri. Same architecture, 96% smaller.

description.p: SideX is a port of Visual Studio Code that replaces Electron with Tauri — a Rust backend and the OS's native webview. The same TypeScript workbench, the same editor, terminal, and Git integration, running without a bundled browser.
Built with Tauri 2, Monaco Editor, and Rust.

screenshot.caption: SideX — VSCode workbench running on Tauri

ul.li: Full VS Code editor experience — syntax highlighting, IntelliSense, extensions
Native app on macOS (Apple Silicon + Intel), Windows (x64 + ARM64), and Linux
Built-in terminal with shell integration (zsh, bash, fish, PowerShell)
Media preview, file watching, fuzzy search, and SCM view
Signed and notarized on macOS and Windows (working)
